JurisdictionPack.title: Jurisdiction pack
JurisdictionPack.description: An UPLOADED jurisdiction pack (jurisdiction-packs design.md D7). Bundled packs — including NL — live in code under lib/Standards/packs/ and are NEVER imported as objects; this schema is the second home, for packs an admin uploads. Both homes are resolved by the same (jurisdiction, taxYear) key, and bundled wins by default: a pack stored here may only claim a key a bundled pack already owns when an admin explicitly activated it as a recorded override. Activation is recorded on THIS object, never read from the author-supplied document.

packId.title: Pack id
packId.description: The pack's declared id, e.g. nl-2026.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: The pack's DECLARED ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 jurisdiction — never parsed from the pack id. Half of the resolver key.

taxYear.title: Tax year
taxYear.description: The pack's DECLARED tax year — never parsed from the pack id. The other half of the resolver key.

packVersion.title: Pack version
packVersion.description: Semver. Stamped onto every run this pack computes as engineVersion = {packId}@{packVersion}.

dslVersion.title: DSL version
dslVersion.description: The interpreter contract this pack was written against.

tables.title: Tables corpus
tables.description: The TaxTables id this pack's @table.* references resolve against. The pack references the verified corpus; it never copies it.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether this pack resolves for its (jurisdiction, taxYear). Set by humaniq only after every validation gate passed — including an in-process dry-run of the pack's own golden vectors.

overridesBundled.title: Overrides a bundled pack
overridesBundled.description: Whether an admin explicitly activated this pack over a bundled pack owning the same key. Overriding the bundled NL pack replaces the engine's regression contract, so it is a deliberate, recorded act — never an accident of upload order.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Any verified:false / placeholder:true corpus leaf this pack resolves. Such leaves do NOT block activation, but are stamped so downstream consumers see a stand-in rather than assuming engine truth.

document.title: Pack document
document.description: The pack's full JSON document, as uploaded. Data only: the DSL has no loops, no recursion and no IO, and a pack can never carry code, a class path or a callable — it names an allow-listed handler or it is rejected.
